0.name: state
0.description: Shared EvmSigninState object holding the tool witness

1.name: message
1.description: The exact bytes that were signed (EIP-191/EIP-712 preimage), hex-encoded. ecrecover Keccak256-hashes these internally.

2.name: signature
2.description: 65-byte secp256k1 signature (r, s, v), hex-encoded. v may be 27/28 (Ethereum) or 0/1 (raw recovery id).

3.name: expected_address
3.description: Optional 20-byte Ethereum address to check the recovered signer against, hex-encoded. Empty to skip the check.
